title: Memo
description: memos/<id>.json: one letter (displayed so; the id is `memo` because `letter` names the handover letter in the code) that a character wrote in the Memos section of its handover letter, one line per memo: `- <kind>: <text> refs: <path>, <path>`. The Steward reads that section when an assignee's run ends through a submit, a question or a crash (not a breaker), files each memo here with an id made from the quest, the kind and the normalized text, so reading the letter again files nothing twice, and routes it by its kind's entry in registry/memos.json (ADR 0024). Characters never write this folder. A memo changes no quest's state and is never answered: the owner decides it once (decide_memo, `elvaria memo decide`) and it is closed.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Events: memo.filed, memo.routed, memo.closed. Not expressible here: state = closed exactly when outcome is present; outcome.quest is required when outcome.decision = handled; the id's day is the day in the quest's id.

from.description: The character whose letter held the memo.

quest.description: The quest whose handover letter held the memo.

attempt.description: The quest's run whose session ended with the memo in its letter.

to.description: The recipient, decided by routeMemo from the registry and, for a judge, from the verdict the run came back with (ADR 0024, PS-22). Later routes add their own fields (the quests of an advisory).

route.description: Where the memo goes, from its kind's entry in registry/memos.json.

verdict.description: (PS-22) Of an objection: the fail verdict it contests; absent when its run came back with none.

refusal.description: (PS-22) Of an objection the owner decides: why no second judge reads it.

refs.description: Files the memo is about, relative to the plot, as the character wrote them ('/' separators).

outcome.description: How the memo was closed: by the decide_memo command, or (PS-22) an objection by its second judge's verdict.

quest.description: With decision = handled: the quest that does the work.

verdict.description: (PS-22) With decision = sustained or overruled: the second judge's verdict.

examples.body: `elvaria quest list` in giờ theo UTC; nên dùng múi giờ của vương quốc như `quest show`.
